about.quote: A good app is one you use without thinking about it.
about.heading: About
about.lead: Design and code, with nothing lost in between.
about.p1: I’ve been building web applications end to end since 2015. Trained in computer science (a DUT in Caen), then as a webmaster (a professional degree), I think about the interface and the code together, for tools that are pleasant to use and easy to evolve.
about.p2: Since 2018, at CICD, I’ve been developing accounting applications used by oil groups: demanding business tools, where reliability matters as much as usability.
about.p3: As a freelancer, I take on short remote missions: a site with online booking, a business tool, an app that needs to grow. You deal with one person, from the first conversation to the launch.
about.p4: I live in the Cotentin, near Cherbourg, by the sea. When I’m not coding, I’m in the water, surfing or paddleboarding, or working on a game.
about.skills_text: What I use day to day. On an existing project, I work with the stack already in place.
